description.value:
Frequency once per day

Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Attempt a Perception or Society check against the target's Deception DC to sense whether it's lying to you right now about the specific thing it just said. On a success you know true or false; on a critical success you also get a one-word impression of what it's hiding. On a failure you get only a guess; on a critical failure, the target realizes you tried and knows it may not be able to trust you either.
